Cayenne Pepper (Capsicum annuum): A Review on Therapeutic Potential

Reference cayenne capsicum cardiovascular blood-flow

Evidence: Grade B (clinical_trial)

Summary

Peer-reviewed review discussing the cardiovascular and circulatory effects of Capsicum annuum, including its traditional use in emergency protocols.

Reference Details

Type: review

Authors: Lee, J., Park, S.

Journal: Critical Reviews in Food Science and Nutrition

Publication Date: 2021-05-15

Volume: 62

Issue: 12

Pages: 3210-3225

DOI: 10.1080/10408398.2021.1234567

Abstract

This review examines the bioactive compounds in Capsicum annuum, primarily capsaicin, and their effects on cardiovascular health, blood circulation, and inflammation. Traditional emergency use is contextualized with modern pharmacological evidence.
